page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 139 at upper right. Main text: Greek verb paradigms in several blocks (Imperfectum, Perfectum, Plusquamperfectum, Infinitum, Futurum, Mox futurum), each with a heading in italic. Marginal notes in the right margin beside each block, giving Latin equivalents.
page.notes: Greek forms are reproduced from a small, worn scan; several accents and breathings are doubtful and may differ from the print. Marginal notes: "Clamabar.", "Clamatus sum.", "Clamatus fueram.", "Clamatus fui.", "Clamabor.", "Mox clamabor."
